text: Initially, all five nodes are separate, so every edge crosses a cluster boundary. The six edge weights add to eighteen, which is our initial cutsize. Nodes A and B, and nodes D and E, each have affinity five. Our tie-break first merges nodes A and B, with combined size two. Their edge becomes internal, reducing cutsize from eighteen to thirteen.

cues.en: Initially, all five nodes are separate, so every edge crosses a cluster boundary.
cues.zh: 初始时五个节点各自成簇，因此每条边都跨越簇边界。

cues.en: The six edge weights add to eighteen, which is our initial cutsize.
cues.zh: 六条边的权重之和为十八，这就是初始割边权重总和。

cues.en: Nodes A and B, and nodes D and E, each have affinity five.
cues.zh: A 与 B、D 与 E 的亲和度都是五。

cues.en: Our tie-break first merges nodes A and B, with combined size two.
cues.zh: 按照平局规则，先合并 A 与 B，合并后的大小为二。

cues.en: Their edge becomes internal, reducing cutsize from eighteen to thirteen.
cues.zh: 它们之间的边变为簇内边，使割边权重总和从十八降到十三。

boundaries.text: Initially, all five nodes are separate, so every edge crosses a cluster boundary.

Nodes A and B, and nodes D and E, each have affinity five.
Our tie-break first merges nodes A and B, with combined size two.
Their edge becomes internal, reducing cutsize from eighteen to thirteen.
